visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor studio with white walls decorated with gaming-themed circular graphics. Three individuals—a man in a vibrant pink hoodie and black beanie, another in a black jacket and a cap with yellow lettering, and a woman in a light blue collared shirt and tie—are seated at a white table. The man in the pink hoodie faces the camera with an expressive face and active hand gestures. (2) A graphical overlay of two red and white arcade machines appears in the center of the frame, surrounded by bold yellow text with a black outline. The man in the pink hoodie continues his micro-actions, pointing and smiling at the camera, while Pokémon cards and merchandise are visible on the table surface. (3) The camera focuses on the man in the black cap on the left side of the screen. He begins gesturing emphatically with a water bottle in his hand. Animated orange and yellow flame effects burst around his torso and head to emphasize his reactions. (4) A still photographic image of a store entrance is shown, featuring the brand logo 'Pokémon Ga-Ole' and a futuristic interior with blue lighting and a Pokéball floor design. (5) The scene returns to the studio group. All three characters are visible in a medium full shot, looking at one another and gesturing as they continue their discussion. The background remains consistent with high-key studio lighting and decorative wall logos.
